discriminating_tests: Robust low-energy parameter correlations from UV fixed-point trajectories.
profiles.name: Asymptotic safety
open_questions: Establish truncation-independent fixed points, unitarity, and observable predictions.
profiles.summary: Ultraviolet completion through a non-Gaussian renormalization-group fixed point.

validity_regimes.description: Ultraviolet gravity and matter flows, currently evaluated through controlled truncations.

discriminating_tests: Haloscopes, helioscopes, laboratory conversion, and astrophysical effects.
profiles.name: Axion and axion-like-particle models
open_questions: Determine whether an axion exists and which production history applies.
profiles.summary: Light pseudoscalar models including the QCD axion and broader axion-like particles.

validity_regimes.description: Weakly coupled light-field regimes across laboratory, astrophysical, and cosmological scales.

key_results: Energy gap, critical behavior, and flux quantization
profiles.name: BCS theory
open_questions: Relate or replace BCS mechanisms in unconventional superconductors.
profiles.summary: Microscopic pairing theory for conventional superconductivity.

validity_regimes.description: Conventional paired superconductors where quasiparticle and pairing assumptions apply.

discriminating_tests: Universal continuum observables and cosmological consequences.
profiles.name: Causal dynamical triangulations
open_questions: Establish a unique continuum limit with matter and observable predictions.
profiles.summary: Nonperturbative lattice path integral over causally structured triangulated geometries.

validity_regimes.description: Lattice-regularized quantum geometry near candidate continuum phases.

discriminating_tests: Nonlocal propagation, cosmological, and discreteness signatures.
profiles.name: Causal set theory
open_questions: Derive manifoldlike dynamics and recover local continuum physics generically.
profiles.summary: Discrete spacetime model based on locally finite causal partial orders.

validity_regimes.description: Fundamental discrete spacetime with manifoldlike continuum sectors.

profiles.name: Classical electrodynamics
open_questions: Control point-charge self-interaction and radiation reaction across regimes.
profiles.summary: Classical electromagnetic fields and their interaction with charge and current.

validity_regimes.description: Macroscopic electromagnetic fields where quantum fluctuations are negligible.

profiles.name: Classical mechanics
open_questions: Derive classical behavior and irreversibility from quantum dynamics in general settings.
profiles.summary: Deterministic dynamics of bodies described by forces or stationary action.

validity_regimes.description: Nonrelativistic, nonquantum systems at scales where continuum trajectories apply.

discriminating_tests: Higgs coupling deviations and partner resonances.
foundations: New confining or strongly coupled sector
profiles.name: Composite Higgs models
open_questions: Identify viable strong dynamics and flavor structure.
profiles.summary: Models in which the Higgs is a bound state or pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone mode of new dynamics.

validity_regimes.description: Above compositeness scales with low-energy effective Higgs deviations.

discriminating_tests: Fixed-target, collider, beam-dump, astrophysical, and direct-detection signatures.
foundations: Portal coupling to Standard Model fields
profiles.name: Dark-photon models
open_questions: Identify dark-sector matter content and symmetry-breaking mechanism.
profiles.summary: Hidden U(1) gauge-boson models coupled through kinetic or related portals.

validity_regimes.description: Weak portal couplings over model-dependent dark-photon masses.

profiles.name: Density functional theory
open_questions: Construct systematically accurate general exchange-correlation functionals.
profiles.summary: Ground-state many-electron framework based on functionals of particle density.

validity_regimes.description: Electronic ground states subject to approximation-dependent exchange-correlation control.

discriminating_tests: Redshift dependence of expansion and growth, clustering, and equivalence-principle effects.
profiles.name: Dynamical dark-energy models
open_questions: Establish a technically natural microphysical origin and stable dynamics.
profiles.summary: Models replacing a constant vacuum term with evolving fields or effective components.

validity_regimes.description: Late-time cosmic acceleration under model-specific stability conditions.

key_results: Systematic low-energy corrections with uncertainty estimates
profiles.name: Effective field theory
open_questions: Determine UV completions and convergence or truncation limits case by case.
profiles.summary: Scale-separated expansion encoding low-energy physics without a specified ultraviolet completion.

validity_regimes.description: Processes sufficiently below a controlled cutoff.

profiles.name: Electroweak theory
open_questions: Determine whether the observed Higgs sector is elementary and minimal.
profiles.summary: Unified SU(2)L x U(1)Y gauge description of weak and electromagnetic interactions.

validity_regimes.description: Electroweak and lower-energy interactions within the Standard Model.

discriminating_tests: Distinct reconstruction relations or low-energy deviations in concrete models.
profiles.name: Emergent-spacetime programs
open_questions: Derive universal local dynamics, causal structure, and realistic matter.
profiles.summary: Programs deriving geometry and gravity from entanglement, information, or collective degrees of freedom.

validity_regimes.description: Controlled toy models and holographic sectors; general spacetime reconstruction remains open.

discriminating_tests: Kaluza-Klein states, missing energy, and short-distance gravity.
profiles.name: Extra-dimensional models
open_questions: Select geometry, stabilization, and Standard Model localization.
profiles.summary: Models with additional spatial dimensions, compactification, branes, or warped geometry.

validity_regimes.description: Model-dependent compactification and Kaluza-Klein scales.

discriminating_tests: Strong-field consistency and polarization tests with gravitational waves.
profiles.name: General relativity
open_questions: Resolve singularities and obtain a confirmed quantum completion.
profiles.summary: Classical gravitation as dynamical Lorentzian spacetime geometry.

validity_regimes.description: Classical spacetime outside regimes requiring quantum gravity.

discriminating_tests: Proton decay, coupling relations, and relic signatures.
foundations: Symmetry breaking to the Standard Model
profiles.name: Grand unified theories
open_questions: Select the gauge group, breaking chain, and matter content.
profiles.summary: Gauge frameworks embedding Standard Model interactions in a larger symmetry.

validity_regimes.description: High-energy completion above unification and symmetry-breaking scales.

discriminating_tests: Condensate-cosmology and continuum-limit signatures.
profiles.name: Group field theory
open_questions: Control renormalization, continuum emergence, and observationally distinct predictions.
profiles.summary: Quantum field theories on group manifolds whose quanta encode discrete geometry.

validity_regimes.description: Pregeometric many-body and condensate sectors with continuum reconstruction under study.

discriminating_tests: Internal duality checks and model-specific quantum-simulation analogues.
key_results: Nonperturbative definitions and calculational dictionaries in controlled examples
profiles.name: Holographic duality
open_questions: Extend to realistic cosmology and finite-parameter quantum gravity.
profiles.summary: Dual descriptions relating gravitational theories to lower-dimensional quantum systems.

validity_regimes.description: Best-controlled in specific asymptotic geometries, symmetries, and large-parameter limits.

key_results: Fluid flow, sound, diffusion, and transport
profiles.name: Hydrodynamics
open_questions: Establish universal far-from-equilibrium closures.
profiles.summary: Long-wavelength effective dynamics of conserved densities and fluid variables.

validity_regimes.description: Scales long compared with microscopic relaxation lengths and times.

discriminating_tests: Primordial tensor modes and model-specific non-Gaussianity.
foundations: Quantum origin of perturbations in common realizations
profiles.name: Inflationary cosmology
open_questions: Identify the mechanism, initial conditions, reheating, and model selection.
profiles.summary: Accelerated early-universe expansion generating a smooth universe and primordial perturbations.

validity_regimes.description: Pre-hot-Big-Bang early-universe epoch in model-dependent energy ranges.

discriminating_tests: Cross-probe expansion and growth consistency.
profiles.name: Lambda-CDM cosmology
open_questions: Identify dark matter and explain dark energy and parameter tensions.
profiles.summary: Baseline cosmological model with general relativity, cold dark matter, and a cosmological constant.

validity_regimes.description: Large-scale homogeneous cosmology and calibrated structure formation.

profiles.name: Lattice gauge theory
open_questions: Control sign problems and real-time dynamics generally.
profiles.summary: Nonperturbative regularization and numerical evaluation of gauge theories on a lattice.

validity_regimes.description: Finite lattice spacing and volume with controlled continuum extrapolation.

discriminating_tests: Model-specific cosmological, black-hole, or propagation signatures.
profiles.name: Loop quantum gravity
open_questions: Complete dynamics, semiclassical limit, matter coupling, and unique predictions.
profiles.summary: Background-independent canonical quantization of gravitational geometry using connection variables.

validity_regimes.description: Planck-scale quantum geometry with classical and semiclassical limits under study.

discriminating_tests: Gravitational-wave propagation, growth-slip relations, screening, and strong-field tests.
foundations: Additional gravitational degrees of freedom or altered geometric dynamics
profiles.name: Modified-gravity models
open_questions: Maintain consistency, stability, and agreement across all tested gravity regimes.
profiles.summary: Covariant alternatives or extensions to general relativity across gravitational scales.

validity_regimes.description: Model-dependent departures from general relativity with screening or recovery limits.

discriminating_tests: External-field effects, galaxy scaling laws, lensing, clusters, and cosmology.
profiles.name: Modified Newtonian dynamics
open_questions: Provide a unique relativistic completion consistent with clusters and cosmology.
profiles.summary: Low-acceleration modification introduced to describe galaxy dynamics without conventional dark matter.

validity_regimes.description: Low-acceleration galactic systems; relativistic completion is model dependent.

discriminating_tests: Model-specific Lorentz, dispersion, or particle-physics signatures.
profiles.name: Noncommutative-geometry models
open_questions: Select physical spectral data and derive unique testable corrections.
profiles.summary: Geometric frameworks replacing coordinate algebras with noncommutative operator algebras.

validity_regimes.description: Fundamental or effective noncommutative spacetime models with commutative low-energy limits.

profiles.name: Quantum chromodynamics
open_questions: Prove four-dimensional confinement and the Yang-Mills mass gap.
profiles.summary: Nonabelian SU(3) gauge theory of quarks and gluons.

validity_regimes.description: Strong interactions from perturbative high energy to nonperturbative hadronic scales.

profiles.name: Quantum field theory
open_questions: Construct interacting four-dimensional models rigorously in broad generality.
profiles.summary: Relativistic quantum framework with fields, locality, symmetries, and particles.

validity_regimes.description: Quantum field descriptions below their cutoff and within controlled sectors.

discriminating_tests: Precision tests of unitarity and proposed nonlinear modifications.
profiles.name: Quantum mechanics
open_questions: Resolve or operationally delimit the measurement problem.
profiles.summary: State-vector or operator framework for quantum probabilities and dynamics.

validity_regimes.description: Nonrelativistic or finite-degree quantum systems within tested coherence scales.

profiles.name: Special relativity
profiles.summary: Lorentz-invariant kinematics and dynamics in nongravitating inertial frames.

validity_regimes.description: Local inertial frames with negligible spacetime curvature.

discriminating_tests: Precision deviations and direct production beyond Standard Model predictions.
foundations: SU(3)c x SU(2)L x U(1)Y gauge symmetry
profiles.name: Standard Model of particle physics
open_questions: Explain neutrino masses, flavor parameters, dark matter, and baryon asymmetry.
profiles.summary: Gauge quantum field theory of known nongravitational elementary particles and interactions.

validity_regimes.description: Tested particle interactions below observed new-physics thresholds.

profiles.name: Statistical mechanics
open_questions: Establish general nonequilibrium closure and thermalization conditions.
profiles.summary: Statistical description connecting microscopic states to macroscopic behavior.

validity_regimes.description: Systems with many degrees of freedom and a justified ensemble or kinetic description.

discriminating_tests: Oscillation distortions, beta spectra, decays, and cosmological constraints.
profiles.name: Sterile-neutrino models
open_questions: Determine the number, masses, mixings, and cosmological history of sterile states.
profiles.summary: Neutrino-sector extensions containing gauge-singlet fermions.

validity_regimes.description: Model-dependent mass and mixing ranges.

discriminating_tests: Model-specific cosmic, particle, gravitational, or compactification signatures.
profiles.name: String and M-theory
open_questions: Select a vacuum and derive unique low-energy physics with testable predictions.
profiles.summary: Quantum framework based on extended objects, extra dimensions, dualities, and higher-dimensional completion.

validity_regimes.description: Perturbative and nonperturbative sectors with background- and compactification-dependent limits.

discriminating_tests: Direct superpartner production and precision virtual effects.
profiles.name: Supersymmetry
open_questions: Determine the breaking mechanism and whether superpartners exist.
profiles.summary: Extensions relating bosonic and fermionic degrees of freedom through spacetime symmetry.

validity_regimes.description: Model-dependent energies above superpartner thresholds or in exact formal sectors.

foundations: State functions and equations of state
profiles.name: Thermodynamics
open_questions: Characterize far-from-equilibrium thermodynamics generically.
profiles.summary: Macroscopic laws governing energy, entropy, work, heat, and equilibrium.

validity_regimes.description: Macroscopic systems admitting stable thermodynamic state variables.

key_results: Compact descriptions of field equations and scattering structures
profiles.name: Twistor theory
open_questions: Establish a complete realistic quantum-gravity formulation.
profiles.summary: Reformulation of spacetime and field structures in terms of complex twistor geometry.

validity_regimes.description: Especially effective for conformal, massless, and scattering-amplitude structures.

scope: Representative profiles spanning established theories, effective descriptions, Standard Model and cosmological frameworks, beyond-Standard-Model programs, and major quantum-gravity approaches. New profiles and relation kinds can be added as data.
